title.description: One line naming the task, which the delegation is listed by.

instruction.description: The task, with every piece of context it needs: what to find or do, where, on which machine, and what the answer must hold. The helper sees nothing of the conversation.

role.description: The role whose agents carry the task and whose tier the seat is asked at; the policy's role for delegated work, the helper, where none is named.

folder.description: Where to work; the asking agent's scratch workspace where none is named.
